summary.t: Snowflake, mitten, little house, bell or bauble, engraved with Nordic patterns.

text.t:
An enchanting set of six plywood Christmas symbols, delicately laser-engraved: a heart, a gingerbread house, a bell, a mitten, a bauble, and a snowflake.
Each piece comes with a red and white decorative string, finished with a delicate bow, adding a classic and elegant touch.
Perfect for decorating your Christmas tree with charm, simplicity, and the magic of the small details that make this season so special.
The set of six is sold together, or you can purchase each symbol individually.

gpsr.warnings.0.t: This is an ornament and not a toy: hang it out of reach of young children, who may put it in their mouths.
